name: tabs
summary: Underline tabs whose indicator moves like liquid, leading edge first.
props: { value, label, icon?, badge?, content?, disabled?, accessibilityLabel? }[]
Tabs and (optionally) their content panes. `icon` is a node or `({ active, color }) => node`.
Called when a tab is pressed or swiped to.
`true` sizes tabs to labels and scrolls; `false` gives equal widths. Default fills the width and scrolls only when tabs overflow, keeping the active tab centred.
Drag the content sideways to change tab; the underline tracks the drag.
How content changes on a tap.
Deprecated: `pill` and `soft` render as `underline` — use SegmentedControl for a pill switch.
Style for the root view wrapping the tab bar and content.
behavior: Tap a tab or drag the content panes sideways; the underline follows your finger, with rubber-band resistance at the ends.
The underline is measured to each label and springs with the leading edge first. Badges pop, and an overflowing bar scrolls to centre the active tab.
Springs become short timings, the bar scrolls without animating and badges change without the pop.
A selection tick on every change; turn it off with haptics={false}.
The bar is a tablist of tabs with selected and disabled state; badges are read with the label, and inactive panes are hidden.
